approved.en: Russian forces have continued drone and missile strikes on Ukrainian civilian sites, including a deadly attack on an Oryol electronics plant and repeated hits on Moscow-area airports, while Ukrainian forces have retaliated with strikes on the same airports, a factory in Tolyatti and an airfield in Krasnodar Krai. In occupied Oleshky, a local cease-fire negotiated by Melania Trump has reduced fighting, and a separate truce was agreed for another town. Ukraine reports that Starlink speed restrictions have been lifted, restoring stable connectivity for its military. A secretive Ukrainian deep-strike unit is expanding its campaign, and the conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russiske styrker har fortsatt drone- og missilangrep mot ukrainske sivile mål, inkludert et dødelig angrep på et elektronikkverk i Oryol og gjentatte treff på flyplasser i Moskva-området, mens ukrainske styrker har gjengjeldt med angrep på de samme flyplassene, en fabrikk i Tolyatti og en flyplass i Krasnodar Krai. I den okkuperte byen Oleshky har en lokal våpenhvile forhandlet av Melania Trump redusert kampene, og en egen våpenhvile ble avtalt for en annen by. Ukraina rapporterer at hastighetsbegrensningene på Starlink er opphevet, og stabil tilkobling er gjenopprettet for militæret. En hemmelig ukrainsk dypangrepsenhet utvider sin kampanje, og konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have expanded a lockdown in the occupied West Bank, razing a neighbourhood and demolishing homes in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and two gunmen were killed. Simultaneously an Israeli airstrike struck a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video. Israeli raids in Hebron have displaced thousands of Palestinians and detained dozens. The United Nations has cut food aid, increasing hunger among displaced West Bank residents. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Samtidig traff et israelsk luftangrep en bygning i Nuseirat, Gaza, som ble fanget på video. Israelske raid i Hebron har fordrevet tusenvis av palestinere og arrestert dusinvis. FN har kuttet matstøtten, noe som øker sulten blant de fordrevede innbyggerne på Vestbredden. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has threatened to strike Gulf oil facilities, AI sites and undersea cables and reports seven ships hit in the Hormuz Strait, while missiles struck Saudi Arabia's King Fahd airport, killing one person and wounding eight, prompting the United States to order its personnel to leave Saudi Arabia and advise diplomats to depart. Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement as the United States and Israel draft plans for renewed strikes after the US midterm elections. Saudi Arabia is expanding a missile plant that may produce more powerful missiles. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Dette førte til at USA beordret sitt personell til å forlate Saudi-Arabia og rådet diplomater til å dra. Russlands utenriksminister Lavrov besøkte Teheran og støttet offentlig Iran, og antydet mulig russisk involvering mens USA og Israel lager planer for nye angrep etter USAs midtveisvalg. Saudi-Arabia utvider et missilverksted som kan produsere kraftigere missiler. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have intensified missile and drone strikes on Saudi targets, hitting Riyadh, Khamis Mushait, Dammam airport and an air base, while Saudi air defenses have shot down several missiles and drones over Saudi territory. In Yemen, Houthi attacks on Sanaa and Aden have killed civilians, and Saudi airstrikes in Houthi-controlled areas have also caused civilian deaths, including women and children. The United Nations warns that water supplies are dwindling in the besieged city of Taiz and in another Yemeni city under Houthi siege. Brent crude rose to its highest level since April after Houthi attacks disrupted oil markets. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Jemen har houthi-angrep på Sanaa og Aden drept sivile, og saudiske luftangrep i houthi-kontrollerte områder har også forårsaket sivile dødsfall, inkludert kvinner og barn. FN advarer om at vannforsyningene tømmes i den beleirede byen Taiz og i en annen jemenisk by under houthi-beleiring. Brent-olje steg til sitt høyeste nivå siden april etter at houthi-angrep forstyrret oljemarkedene. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a disabled Syrian man in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus, and further clashes occurred in Rankous and the Damascus countryside. Protesters gathered across Syria to denounce repeated Israeli incursions, while a road linking Damascus and Suwayda was blocked amid demands for detainees' release and the Sweida-Damascus highway was completely closed by outlaw groups. Arms depot explosions in Syria left 37 dead. 2732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et raid på en IS-celle nær Damaskus, og ytterligere sammenstøt fant sted i Rankous og på landsbygda rundt Damaskus. Demonstranter samlet seg over hele Syria for å fordømme gjentatte israelske inntrengninger, mens en vei som forbinder Damaskus og Suwayda ble blokkert i påvente av løslatelse av fanger, og Sweida-Damaskus-motorveien ble helt stengt av ulovlige grupper. Eksplosjoner på våpenlager i Syria førte til 37 døde. 2732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi authorities condemned the deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan and arrested suspects, while Iraqi leaders blamed external agents for the incident. Iranian forces were accused of severe border violations and smuggling, and the Iraqi border with Saudi Arabia was declared fully secured. Pro-Iran factions in Iraq alleged US airspace violations amid a disarmament dispute, and US travel warnings against Iraq remain in effect. The prime minister pledged to place armed factions and weapons under state control by June 2027. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Iranske styrker ble anklaget for alvorlige grensebrudd og smugling, og grensen mellom Irak og Saudi-Arabia ble erklært fullt sikret. Pro-iranske fraksjoner i Irak hevdet at USA hadde brutt luftrommet i forbindelse med en avrustningskonflikt, og amerikanske reiseråd mot Irak er fortsatt i kraft. Statsministeren lovet å plassere væpnede fraksjoner og våpen under statlig kontroll innen juni 2027. 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Communal clashes persist between SSPDF and SPLA-IO forces in Kapoeta North, Eastern Equatoria, and in Wij-Panyikang, Upper Nile, with an ambush that killed two people in Kajo-Keji County. Monitors warned of rising violence ahead of December elections and reported 40,000 people displaced by renewed fighting in Upper Nile. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian federal forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to resolve Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now hold the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have taken Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, and a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE also carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandler 148 sårede etter tungt kamphandling i Baidoa. Etiopia har trukket tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State, og et droneram i Puntland drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring. USA og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte også luftangrep mot al Shabaab i Nord-Somalia, og 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In Nigeria, 600 soldiers are being sent to India for specialised training and militants killed 14 security personnel in an attack on a base. In Niger, two European women were freed after more than a year of captivity and gunmen attacked buses in the north, killing at least twelve people. Mali’s army and Russian fighters are again accused of new civilian abuses. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nigeria blir 600 soldater sendt til India for spesialisert trening, og militante drepte 14 sikkerhetspersonell i et angrep på en base. I Niger ble to europeiske kvinner løslatt etter mer enn ett år i fangenskap, og væpnede menn angrep busser i nord og drepte minst tolv personer. Mali-hæren og russiske krigere blir igjen anklaget for nye overgrep mot sivile. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Gunmen killed an NSCDC officer and abducted a businessman in Plateau despite a curfew, and they attacked an Ebonyi assembly candidate convoy, killing one and wounding three. In Benue, Senate leaders are demanding a security overhaul and troop deployment after 113 people were killed, while electricity workers withdrew services in Makurdi following an alleged attack. Bandits continue to hold a widow, her son and a newborn captive three weeks after a kidnapping in Kaduna, and a NDC supporter was killed in Enugu. Floods killed 245 people and displaced over 200,000, according to NEMA, and the conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Benue krever senatledere en sikkerhetsreform og utplassering av tropper etter at 113 personer ble drept, mens strømarbeidere avbrøt tjenestene i Makurdi etter et påstått angrep. Banditter holder fortsatt en enke, hennes sønn og en nyfødt som fange tre uker etter en kidnapping i Kaduna, og en NDC-tilhenger ble drept i Enugu. Flom drepte 245 personer og fordrev over 200 000, ifølge NEMA, og konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ebola has reached an eighth province in eastern DRC, prompting alerts in Lubumbashi and border closures by Kenya and Uganda after 12 truck drivers were killed. The ADF continues attacks in Ituri while the FRN operates near Lubumbashi, and both UPDF and FARDC are conducting joint operations against ADF commanders in the region. A mercenary force suffered combat casualties in the Congo, and rebel-linked violence has led to civilian deaths. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Overlevende fra Eseka-jernbaneulykken i 2016 venter fortsatt på rettferdighet ti år etter krasjen, og en fransk domstol har gitt en tredjepartsfinansiør tillatelse til å håndheve en ICC-dømmesum mot staten. Styrker knyttet til Erik Prince led et tap på slagmarken i Kongo, med en tidligere UFC-utøver blant de sårede, noe som viser konfliktens regionale spredning. approved.en: Gangs clashed inside two Ecuadorian prisons, killing eight inmates and wounding ten others. The government responded with increased security measures and preventive detention of former candidate Luisa González on alleged money-laundering charges. Political repression and militarization have intensified as President Noboa aligns the country with external security interests. The crisis recorded two battle-related deaths in 2019, according to UCDP.

Regjeringen svarte med skjerpede sikkerhetstiltak og forebyggende fengsling av tidligere kandidat Luisa González på påståtte hvitvaskingsanklager. Politisk undertrykkelse og militarisering har økt ettersom president Noboa tilpasser landet til eksterne sikkerhetsinteresser. Krisen registrerte to dødsfall i kamper i 2019, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The United States has revived a torture indictment against Maduro for ordering torture of rivals and deployed Space Force electromagnetic and electronic warfare systems against Venezuela while pressuring Reliance to refine Venezuelan oil. Opposition groups are staging nationwide protests demanding elections and the return of Machado, and a Dutch security report warns that Venezuela’s instability could threaten Curaçao and the wider Caribbean Kingdom. The Pentagon has issued a directive banning DoD personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations, including those involving Venezuela. The U.S. Embassy has reopened in Venezuela to full staff, and there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2007, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: USA har gjenopptatt en torturanklage mot Maduro for å ha beordret tortur av rivaler og har satt i drift elektromagnetiske og elektroniske krigssystemer fra Space Force mot Venezuela mens de presser Reliance til å raffinere venezuelansk olje. Opposisjonsgrupper holder landsomfattende protester som krever valg og at Machado kommer tilbake, og en nederlandsk sikkerhetsrapport advarer om at Venezuelas ustabilitet kan true Curaçao og det bredere Karibiske kongeriket. Pentagon har gitt en direktiv som forbyr DoD-personell å bruke ikke-offentlig informasjon til å satse på amerikanske militæroperasjoner, inkludert de som involverer Venezuela. Den amerikanske ambassaden har åpnet igjen i Venezuela med fullt personale, og det var 2 dødsfall i kamp i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
